environment_variables.FOCAL_SUBJECT: A classical marble bust of a Greek philosopher. His eyes are completely covered by a chunky, retro 1980s beige VR headset with thick trailing cables.
environment_variables.SUPPORTING_ELEMENTS: A pixelated Windows 95 'Fatal Error' dialog box floating over his chest, halftone-printed binary code melting like wax from the cables, and fine charcoal dotted grids in the background.
environment_variables.OVERLAY_QUOTE: AI IS THINKING SO I DON'T HAVE TO

environment_variables.FOCAL_SUBJECT: A massive, brutalist concrete stepped ziggurat (pyramid). Instead of a peak, it balances a giant, tilted white paper coffee cup spilling a flat, dry-brush swatch of brown coffee.
environment_variables.SUPPORTING_ELEMENTS: Floating torn fragments of Excel spreadsheet grids, a pixelated Windows hourglass loading cursor, and a giant flat terracotta sun acting as a clock stuck at 4:59.

environment_variables.FOCAL_SUBJECT: The beautiful classical plaster profile of a Renaissance sculpture face, aggressively torn down the middle. Inside the paper-like tear, densely packed, flat vintage computer motherboard circuitry is revealed instead of flesh.
environment_variables.SUPPORTING_ELEMENTS: A sharp, high-contrast pixelated 'Disconnected' popup icon covering her eye area, vintage anatomical bird wings trying to fly away, and a single unplugged audio cable hanging down.
environment_variables.OVERLAY_QUOTE: WE ARE ALL JUST BROKEN LINKS

example_cases_16_9.case_name: The Infinite Scroll (无限下拉的虚无)

environment_variables.FOCAL_SUBJECT: A colossal, horizontally reclining classical marble Titan (like a fallen ancient god). His entire body is tightly bound and choked by giant, tangible retro Windows UI scrollbars and thick, tangled grey server cables stretching infinitely across the wide canvas.
environment_variables.SUPPORTING_ELEMENTS: Flocks of pixelated halftone-printed hourglass cursors hovering like flies, a massive flat terracotta sun sinking behind a distant brutalist concrete wall, and rough torn paper edges at the bottom revealing digital static noise.

example_cases_16_9.case_name: The Cloud Pantheon (云端万神殿的遗迹)

environment_variables.FOCAL_SUBJECT: A vast, horizontal brutalist concrete colonnade resembling an ancient Greek temple spreading across the frame. The thick concrete columns are violently shattered open to reveal they are hollow, exposing highly complex, tangled vintage server racks and circuit boards acting as the building's skeleton.
environment_variables.SUPPORTING_ELEMENTS: A giant 8-bit 'Save Icon' (floppy disk) crashing into the marble floor like a meteor, causing a physical shockwave of torn paper textures. Vintage anatomical diagrams of human brains fading into the wide charcoal-grey negative space.

example_cases_16_9.case_name: The Content Factory (流水线上的大卫)

environment_variables.FOCAL_SUBJECT: A panoramic brutalist concrete conveyor belt stretching from left to right. It carries an endless row of perfectly sculpted, identical marble heads of Michelangelo's David. A giant, pixelated white cursor is physically stamping and cracking open the skull of the center David.
environment_variables.SUPPORTING_ELEMENTS: Fine 0.5pt charcoal technical blueprints mapping the assembly line in the background negative space. A sharp, geometric cyber-alert red 'Error' block jammed violently into the concrete gears, with dry-brush terracotta paint bleeding from the machinery.
